name: UI: kit gallery
description: A quiet stage for the in-game TV UI kit (crates/df-playground/src/kit), for development only. A development build of the page opened with ?kit=N draws gallery board N as the whole stage: every kit component in the premium glass look, each board after a concept render or a stress case. The boards are the kit's own sample data (src/kit/gallery.json), compiled into development builds only; no speech line is part of this scene.
